# Font fixtures

Both fonts are under the SIL Open Font License 1.1 ([OFL.txt](OFL.txt)).

- `NotoSans-Latin.ttf` — Noto Sans cut to Latin-1 and a few quotes.
  Copyright 2022 The Noto Project Authors
  (https://github.com/notofonts/latin-greek-cyrillic).
- `VisoSym-subset.otf` — Bravura cut to a few dozen SMuFL symbols, renamed
  `VisoSym` because "Bravura" is a Reserved Font Name; its name table still
  carries the original copyright notice and license.
  Copyright © 2015, Steinberg Media Technologies GmbH
  (http://www.steinberg.net/), with Reserved Font Name "Bravura".
